definitions.explanation: Far superior to others in the same group. Describes something that stands out conspicuously above the rest.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{成績|せいせき}は{抜群|ばつぐん}だ。
このレストランは{味|あじ}も{雰囲気|ふんいき}も{抜群|ばつぐん}にいい。
examples.english: This restaurant is superb in both flavor and atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はチームの{中|なか}でも{抜群|ばつぐん}の{運動能力|うんどうのうりょく}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: He has exceptional athletic ability, even among his teammates.

notes:
{抜群|ばつぐん} literally means "pulled out of the group" — standing out from the crowd. It is used both as a na-adjective and as an adverb ({抜群|ばつぐん}に).

ETYMOLOGY: {抜|ばつ} (to pull out) + {群|ぐん} (group, crowd).

PATTERN:
- {抜群|ばつぐん}の + noun: outstanding ~
- {抜群|ばつぐん}な + noun: outstanding ~ (less common)
- {抜群|ばつぐん}に + adjective/adverb: exceptionally ~
- {抜群|ばつぐん}だ: is outstanding

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抜群|ばつぐん}の{成績|せいせき}: outstanding grades/results
- {抜群|ばつぐん}の{安定感|あんていかん}: exceptional stability
- {抜群|ばつぐん}のセンス: superb taste/sense
- {抜群|ばつぐん}に{美味|おい}しい: exceptionally delicious
- スタイル{抜群|ばつぐん}: with a stunning figure
